{"code":200,"message":"Success to get a dataset","data":{"id":16147,"name":"Jumlah Desa Berdasarkan Tempat Membuang Sampah di Jawa Barat","slug":"jumlah-desa-berdasarkan-tempat-membuang-sampah-di-jawa-barat","deskripsi":"

Dataset ini berisi data jumlah desa berdasarkan tempat membuang sampah di Provinsi Jawa Barat periode tahun 2020 s.d 2024. 

Dataset terkait topik Pemerintah dan Desa ini dihasilkan oleh Dinas Pemberdayaan Masyarakat dan Desa yang dikeluarkan dalam periode 1 tahun sekali. 

Penjelasan mengenai variabel di dalam dataset ini: 
* kode_provinsi: menyatakan kode Provinsi Jawa Barat sesuai ketentuan BPS merujuk pada aturan Peraturan Badan Pusat Statistik Nomor 3 Tahun 2019 dengan tipe data numerik. 
* nama_provinsi: menyatakan lingkup data berasal dari wilayah Provinsi Jawa Barat sesuai ketentuan BPS merujuk pada aturan Peraturan Badan Pusat Statistik Nomor 3 Tahun 2019 dengan tipe data teks. 
* kode_kabupaten_kota: menyatakan kode dari setiap kabupaten dan kota di Provinsi Jawa Barat sesuai ketentuan BPS merujuk pada aturan Peraturan Badan Pusat Statistik Nomor 3 Tahun 2019 dengan tipe data numerik. 
* nama_kabupaten_kota: menyatakan lingkup data berasal dari setiap kabupaten dan kota di Provinsi Jawa Barat sesuai penamaan BPS merujuk pada aturan Peraturan Badan Pusat Statistik Nomor 3 Tahun 2019 dengan tipe data teks. 
* kategori_tempat_sampah: menyatakan kategori tempat membuang sampah dengan tipe data teks. 
* dalam lubang atau dibakar: menyatakan kategori tempat membuang sampah ke dalam lubang atau dibakar. 
* sungai/saluran irigasi/danau/laut/got/selokan: menyatakan kategori tempat membuang sampah ke sungai/saluran irigasi/danau/ laut/got/selokan. 
* tempat sampah kemudian diangkut: menyatakan kategori tempat membuang sampah ke tempat sampah kemudian diangkut. 
* lainnya: menyatakan kategori tempat membuang sampah ke lainnya. 
* jumlah_desa: menyatakan jumlah desa dengan tipe data numerik. 
* satuan: menyatakan satuan dari pengukuran jumlah desa dalam desa dengan tipe data teks. 
* tahun: menyatakan tahun produksi data dengan tipe data numerik.

Dataset ini berisi data jumlah sampah yang ditangani berdasarkan kabupaten/kota di Provinsi Jawa Barat dari tahun 2015 s.d. 2023.

  • jumlah_sampah: menyatakan jumlah sampah yang ditangani dengan tipe data numerik.
  • satuan: menyatakan satuan dari pengukuran jumlah sampah yang ditangani dalam ton per hari dengan tipe data teks.

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const heroSection = document.getElementById('heroSection');
        const layerBg = document.getElementById('layerBg');
        const layerMid = document.getElementById('layerMid');
        const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in-up');
        
        // 1. Initial Fade In Animation
        const observerOptions = { threshold: 0.1 };
        const appearObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    animatedElements.forEach(el => {
                        el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.8s ease-out, transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)';
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            el.style.opacity = '1';
                            el.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                        }, parseFloat(el.style.animationDelay || 0) * 1000);
                    });
                    appearObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);
        
        appearObserver.observe(heroSection);

        // 2. Parallax Logic with Optimization
        let isHeroVisible = true;
        
        const visibilityObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                isHeroVisible = entry.isIntersecting;
            });
        });
        visibilityObserver.observe(heroSection);

        function updateParallax() {
            if (!isHeroVisible) {
                requestAnimationFrame(updateParallax);
                return;
            }

            const scrollY = window.scrollY;
            const speedBg = 0.4; 
            const speedMid = 0.2; 
            
            if(layerBg) layerBg.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${scrollY * speedBg}px, 0)`;
            if(layerMid) layerMid.style.transform = `translate3d(${scrollY * 0.05}px, ${scrollY * speedMid}px, 0)`;

            requestAnimationFrame(updateParallax);
        }

        const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
            requestAnimationFrame(updateParallax);
        }
    });
</script>

    <script>
        // Alias Chosen to Select2 for maximum compatibility
        if (window.jQuery && typeof jQuery.fn.select2 === 'function') {
            jQuery.fn.chosen = function(options) {
                return this.select2(options);
            };
        }

        function handleDashboardFilterChange(selectEl) {
            if (!selectEl) return;
            if (selectEl._submitting) return;
            const form = selectEl.form;
            if (!form) return;
            selectEl._submitting = true;

            const resetFields = (selectEl.dataset.cascadeReset || '').split(',').map(function (field) {
                return field.trim();
            }).filter(Boolean);

            resetFields.forEach(function (fieldName) {
                const child = form.querySelector('[name="' + fieldName + '"]');
                if (child) {
                    child.value = '';
                }
            });

            form.submit();
        }

        // Initialize Select2 / Chosen on all filter dropdowns
        $(document).ready(function() {
            var filterSelectors = '.filter-select, .chosen-select, .filter-box select, .filters-bar select, .wcc-filters select, select[name="kabupaten"]';
            
            $(filterSelectors).each(function() {
                var $this = $(this);
                if ($this.hasClass('select2-hidden-accessible')) {
                    return;
                }
                
                $this.addClass('chosen-select');

                $this.select2({
                    width: '100%',
                    dropdownAutoWidth: true,
                    dropdownParent: $('body'),
                    minimumResultsForSearch: 0, // always enable search box (chosen behavior)
                    language: {
                        noResults: function() {
                            return "Tidak ada data ditemukan";
                        }
                    }
                });
            });

            // Handle filter change for Select2 / Chosen selections
            $(document).on('change', 'select.filter-select, select.chosen-select', function() {
                var el = this;
                if (el._submitting) return;

                if (el.dataset.cascadeReset !== undefined) {
                    handleDashboardFilterChange(el);
                } else if (el.getAttribute('onchange') && el.getAttribute('onchange').indexOf('form.submit') !== -1) {
                    if (el.form) {
                        el._submitting = true;
                        el.form.submit();
                    }
                }
            });
        });

            var upperName = geoName.toUpperCase().trim();
            
            // Direct match

            if (cityLookupAlt[upperName]) return cityLookupAlt[upperName];
            
            // Fuzzy match - check if keys contain each other
            var normalizedNoSpaces = normalizedKey.replace(/\s+/g, '').replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
            
            // Check against extra keys

            for (var key in cityLookup) {
                 // Check if normalized keys match partially
                if (normalizedKey.includes(key) || key.includes(normalizedKey)) {
                    return cityLookup[key];
                }
                
                // Check stripped versions
                var keyNoSpaces = key.replace(/\s+/g, '').replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
                if (normalizedNoSpaces === keyNoSpaces) {

            var tVal = parseNumber(row.timbulan);
            row.timbulan = tVal; // Update the row object in place for easier access later

            if (tVal > 0) {
                stats.minTimbulan = Math.min(stats.minTimbulan, tVal);
                stats.maxTimbulan = Math.max(stats.maxTimbulan, tVal);
            }

        if (stats.minTimbulan === Infinity) stats.minTimbulan = 0;
        if (stats.maxTimbulan === -Infinity) stats.maxTimbulan = 1000;

        /**

         */

            var map = L.map(containerId, {
            }).setView(CONFIG.defaultCenter, CONFIG.defaultZoom);
            
            L.tileLayer(CONFIG.tileUrl, {
                maxZoom: 16,
                attribution: CONFIG.tileAttribution
            }).addTo(map);

            L.tileLayer(CONFIG.labelTileUrl, {
                maxZoom: 16,
                pane: 'shadowPane'
            }).addTo(map);
            
            return map;
        }

        /**
         * Create GeoJSON layer for Timbulan map
         */
        function createTimbulanLayer(geoData) {
            return L.geoJSON(geoData, {
                style: function(feature) {
                    var name = feature.properties.WADMKK || feature.properties.NAMOBJ || feature.properties.Name || feature.properties.name || '';
                    var cityData = findCityData(name);
                    var tVal = cityData ? parseNumber(cityData.timbulan) : 0;
                    var finalColor = getTimbulanColor(tVal);

                    return {
                        fillColor: finalColor,
                        weight: 1.5,
                        opacity: 0.8,
                        color: finalColor,
                        fillOpacity: 0.5,
                        fill: true
                    };
                },
                onEachFeature: function(feature, layer) {
                    var name = feature.properties.WADMKK || feature.properties.NAMOBJ || feature.properties.Name || feature.properties.name || 'Unknown';
                    var province = feature.properties.WADMPR || feature.properties.PROVINSI || feature.properties.Province || '';
                    var cityData = findCityData(name);
                    var tVal = cityData ? parseNumber(cityData.timbulan) : 0;
                    var munculColor = getTimbulanColor(tVal);

                    // Build tooltip content
                    var tooltipContent = '<div class="tt-container">';
                    tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-header">';
                    tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-header-left">';
                    tooltipContent += '<span class="tt-title">' + name + '</span>';
                    if (province) tooltipContent += '<span class="tt-sub">' + province + '</span>';
                    tooltipContent += '</div>';
                    tooltipContent += '<button type="button" class="tt-close" aria-label="Tutup detail">×</button>';
                    tooltipContent += '</div>';

                    if (cityData) {
                        var tVal = parseNumber(cityData.timbulan);
                        var terkelola = rowManagedPercent(cityData);
                        var tidakTerkelola = Math.max(0, 100 - terkelola);

                        tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-body">';
                        tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-label">Timbulan</span><span class="tt-val">' + formatNumber(tVal) + ' tpd</span></div>';
                        tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-label">Terkelola</span><span class="tt-val" style="color:#16a34a">' + formatNumber(terkelola) + '%</span></div>';
                        tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-label">Belum Terkelola</span><span class="tt-val" style="color:#dc2626">' + formatNumber(tidakTerkelola) + '%</span></div>';
                        tooltipContent += '</div>';
                    } else {
                        tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-body"><em style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:0.8rem;">Data belum tersedia</em></div>';
                    }
                    tooltipContent += '</div>';

                    // Click to show floating tooltip card
                    layer.on('click', function(e) {
                        L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e);
                        showFloatingTooltip(map1, tooltipContent, e);
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        /**
         * Create GeoJSON layer for Solusi map
         */
        function createSolusiLayer(geoData) {

                style: function(feature) {
                    var name = feature.properties.WADMKK || feature.properties.NAMOBJ || feature.properties.Name || feature.properties.name || '';
                    var cityData = findCityData(name);
                    var solusi = getSolusiCategory(cityData);
                    
                    return {
                        fillColor: solusi.color,
                        weight: 1.5,
                        opacity: 0.8,
                        color: solusi.color,
                        fillOpacity: 0.5,
                        fill: true
                    };
                },
                onEachFeature: function(feature, layer) {
                    var name = feature.properties.WADMKK || feature.properties.NAMOBJ || feature.properties.Name || feature.properties.name || 'Unknown';
                    var province = feature.properties.WADMPR || feature.properties.PROVINSI || feature.properties.Province || '';
                    var cityData = findCityData(name);
                    var solusi = getSolusiCategory(cityData);
                    
                    // Build tooltip content
                    var tooltipContent = '<div class="tt-container">';
                    tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-header">';
                    tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-header-left">';
                    tooltipContent += '<span class="tt-title">' + name + '</span>';
                    if (province) tooltipContent += '<span class="tt-sub">' + province + '</span>';
                    tooltipContent += '</div>';
                    tooltipContent += '<button type="button" class="tt-close" aria-label="Tutup detail">×</button>';
                    tooltipContent += '</div>';

                    tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-body">';
                    tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-row" style="margin-bottom:8px;">';
                    tooltipContent += '<span class="tt-label">Solusi Utama</span>';
                    tooltipContent += '</div>';

                    tooltipContent += '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:12px;">';
                    tooltipContent += '<div style="width:12px; height:12px; background:' + solusi.color + '; border-radius:3px;"></div>';
                    tooltipContent += '<span class="tt-val">' + solusi.type + '</span>';
                    tooltipContent += '</div>';

                    if (cityData) {
                        var bsu = parseInt(cityData.bsu_aktif) || parseInt(cityData.jumlah_bsu) || 0;
                        var bsi = parseInt(cityData.bsi_aktif) || parseInt(cityData.jumlah_bsi) || 0;
                        var tps3r = parseInt(cityData.tps_3r_aktif) || parseInt(cityData.mrf_10_tpd_aktif) || 0;

                        tooltipContent += '<div style="border-top:1px dashed #e2e8f0; margin:8px 0; padding-top:8px;">';
                        tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-label">BSU Aktif</span><span class="tt-val">' + formatNumber(bsu) + '</span></div>';
                        tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-label">BSI Aktif</span><span class="tt-val">' + formatNumber(bsi) + '</span></div>';
                        tooltipContent += '<div class="tt-row"><span class="tt-label">TPS 3R Aktif</span><span class="tt-val">' + formatNumber(tps3r) + '</span></div>';
                        tooltipContent += '</div>';
                    }
                    tooltipContent += '</div>'; // end body
                    tooltipContent += '</div>'; // end container

                    // Click to show floating tooltip card
                    layer.on('click', function(e) {
                        L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e);
                        showFloatingTooltip(map2, tooltipContent, e);
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        /**
         * Add legend for Timbulan map
         */
        function addTimbulanLegend(map) {
            var legend = L.control({ position: 'bottomleft' });
            legend.onAdd = function() {
                var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'legend-box');
                div.style.cssText = 'background:white; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:6px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); font-size:12px;';
                div.innerHTML = 
                    '<div style="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px; color:#333;">Timbulan (Ton/Hari)</div>' +
                    '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">' +
                        '<span style="color:#666;">' + formatNumber(stats.minTimbulan) + '</span>' +
                        '<div style="height:12px; width:100px; background:linear-gradient(to right, #4caf50, #8bc34a, #cddc39, #ffeb3b, #ff9800, #f44336, #d32f2f, #b71c1c); border-radius:2px;"></div>' +
                        '<span style="color:#666;">' + formatNumber(stats.maxTimbulan) + '</span>' +
                    '</div>';
                return div;
            };
            legend.addTo(map);
        }

        /**
         * Add legend for Solusi map
         */
        function addSolusiLegend(map) {
            var legend = L.control({ position: 'bottomright' });
            legend.onAdd = function() {
                var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'legend-box');
                div.style.cssText = 'background:white; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:6px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); font-size:11px;';
                
                var items = [
                    { label: 'WtE/PSEL', color: COLORS.solusi['WtE/PSEL'] },
                    { label: 'TPST RDF', color: COLORS.solusi['TPST RDF'] },
                    { label: 'TPS 3R/BSI', color: COLORS.solusi['TPS 3R/BSI'] },
                    { label: 'Belum ada status', color: COLORS.solusi['Belum ada status'] }
                ];
                
                var html = '<div style="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px; color:#333;">Bauran Solusi Utama</div>';
                items.forEach(function(item) {
                    html += '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-bottom:4px;">' +
                        '<div style="width:14px; height:14px; background:' + item.color + '; border-radius:3px; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"></div>' +
                        '<span style="color:#555;">' + item.label + '</span>' +
                    '</div>';
                });
                div.innerHTML = html;
                return div;
            };
            legend.addTo(map);
        }

        // INITIALIZE MAPS
        // =====================================================
        var map1, map2;

        // Create maps
        map1 = createMap('mapTimbulan');
        map2 = createMap('mapSolusi');
        map1.on('click', closeFloatingTooltip);
        map2.on('click', closeFloatingTooltip);

        // Load GeoJSON and add layers (lazy: setelah paint pertama)
        var loadMaps = function() {
        fetch(CONFIG.geoJsonUrl)
            .then(function(response) {
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load GeoJSON');
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(function(geoData) {
                geoJsonData = geoData;

                // Add Timbulan layer
                var timbulanLayer = createTimbulanLayer(geoData);
                timbulanLayer.addTo(map1);
                
                // Add Solusi layer
                var solusiLayer = createSolusiLayer(geoData);
                solusiLayer.addTo(map2);
                
                // =====================================================
                // AUTO-ZOOM TO FILTERED REGION
                // =====================================================
                var filterBounds = null;
                
                // Check if there's an active filter
                if (FILTER.kotaKabupaten) {
                    // Zoom to specific city/kabupaten
                    console.log('Zooming to city:', FILTER.kotaKabupaten);
                    var targetName = normalizeName(FILTER.kotaKabupaten);
                    
                    timbulanLayer.eachLayer(function(layer) {
                        var featureName = layer.feature.properties.Name || layer.feature.properties.name || '';
                        if (normalizeName(featureName) === targetName || 
                            featureName.toUpperCase().includes(FILTER.kotaKabupaten.toUpperCase()) ||
                            FILTER.kotaKabupaten.toUpperCase().includes(featureName.toUpperCase())) {
                            if (!filterBounds) {
                                filterBounds = layer.getBounds();
                            } else {
                                filterBounds.extend(layer.getBounds());
                            }
                        }
                    });
                } else if (FILTER.provinsi) {
                    // Zoom to province - collect all cities in that province
                    console.log('Zooming to province:', FILTER.provinsi);
                    var normalizedProvince = FILTER.provinsi.toUpperCase().trim();
                    
                    timbulanLayer.eachLayer(function(layer) {
                        var featureProvince = (layer.feature.properties.WADMPR || layer.feature.properties.PROVINSI || layer.feature.properties.Province || '').toUpperCase().trim();
                        
                        // Match province name (handle variations like "JAWA BARAT" vs "JAWA BARAT")
                        if (featureProvince === normalizedProvince || 
                            featureProvince.includes(normalizedProvince) || 
                            normalizedProvince.includes(featureProvince)) {
                            if (!filterBounds) {
                                filterBounds = layer.getBounds();
                            } else {
                                filterBounds.extend(layer.getBounds());
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Apply bounds
                if (filterBounds && filterBounds.isValid()) {
                    map1.fitBounds(filterBounds, { padding: [30, 30], maxZoom: 12 });
                    map2.fitBounds(filterBounds, { padding: [30, 30], maxZoom: 12 });
                } else {
                    // Default: fit to all data
                    if (timbulanLayer.getBounds().isValid()) {
                        map1.fitBounds(timbulanLayer.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20] });
                    }
                    if (solusiLayer.getBounds().isValid()) {
                        map2.fitBounds(solusiLayer.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20] });
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(function(error) {
                console.error('Error loading GeoJSON:', error);
                document.getElementById('mapTimbulan').innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:#999;"><span>Gagal memuat data peta</span></div>';
                document.getElementById('mapSolusi').innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:#999;"><span>Gagal memuat data peta</span></div>';
            });
        };

        // Add legends
        addTimbulanLegend(map1);
        addSolusiLegend(map2);

        // Force map resize after a delay
        setTimeout(function() {
            map1.invalidateSize();
            map2.invalidateSize();
        }, 500);

        // GeoJSON ~1MB: muat setelah browser idle agar First Paint lebih cepat
        if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
            requestIdleCallback(loadMaps, { timeout: 2000 });
        } else {
            setTimeout(loadMaps, 200);
        }

    });
</script>

  <style>
    /* CSS variables supporting dynamic theme colors */
    :root {
      transition: background-color 0.5s ease, color 0.5s ease;
    }

    /* Light Mode Style Tokens */
    :root.light-mode {
      --bg-dark: #f1f5f9;
      --bg-gradient-start: #f8fafc;
      --bg-gradient-end: #cbd5e1;
      --bg-card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      --card-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
      --card-shadow-rgb: 15, 23, 42;
      --text-main: #0f172a;
      --text-muted: #334155;
      --text-dim: #64748b;
      --meta-bg: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
      --meta-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);

      /* Dynamic accent defaults */
      --theme-color: #ef4444;
      --theme-glow: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08);
      --theme-text: #dc2626;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.05);
    }

    /* Dark Mode Style Tokens (Rich Slate/Navy) */
    :root.dark-mode {
      --bg-dark: #0f172a;
      --bg-gradient-start: #1e293b;
      --bg-gradient-end: #090d16;
      --bg-card: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.75);
      --card-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
      --card-shadow-rgb: 0, 0, 0;
      --text-main: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #cbd5e1;
      --text-dim: #64748b;
      --meta-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      --meta-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);

      /* Dynamic accent defaults */
      --theme-color: #f87171;
      --theme-glow: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.18);
      --theme-text: #fca5a5;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.08);
    }

    /* Success Theme overrides */
    :root.light-mode.theme-success {
      --theme-color: #10b981;
      --theme-glow: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);
      --theme-text: #059669;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05);
    }

    :root.dark-mode.theme-success {
      --theme-color: #34d399;
      --theme-glow: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.18);
      --theme-text: #6ee7b7;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.08);
    }

    /* Redirect Theme overrides */
    :root.light-mode.theme-redirect {
      --theme-color: #3b82f6;
      --theme-glow: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08);
      --theme-text: #2563eb;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05);
    }

    :root.dark-mode.theme-redirect {
      --theme-color: #60a5fa;
      --theme-glow: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.18);
      --theme-text: #93c5fd;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.08);
    }

    /* Client Error Theme overrides */
    :root.light-mode.theme-client {
      --theme-color: #f59e0b;
      --theme-glow: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08);
      --theme-text: #b45309;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05);
    }

    :root.dark-mode.theme-client {
      --theme-color: #fbbf24;
      --theme-glow: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.18);
      --theme-text: #fcd34d;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.08);
    }

    /* Server Error Theme overrides */
    :root.light-mode.theme-server {
      --theme-color: #ef4444;
      --theme-glow: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08);
      --theme-text: #dc2626;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.05);
    }

    :root.dark-mode.theme-server {
      --theme-color: #f87171;
      --theme-glow: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.18);
      --theme-text: #fca5a5;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.08);
    }

    /* Security Theme overrides */
    :root.light-mode.theme-security {
      --theme-color: #9333ea;
      --theme-glow: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.08);
      --theme-text: #7e22ce;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.05);
    }

    :root.dark-mode.theme-security {
      --theme-color: #c084fc;
      --theme-glow: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.18);
      --theme-text: #d8b4fe;
      --theme-bg-soft: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.08);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      background-color: var(--bg-dark);
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, var(--bg-gradient-start), var(--bg-gradient-end));
      color: var(--text-main);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 40px 24px;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* Page Header */
    .page-header {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 720px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .header-logo {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .theme-toggle-btn {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      color: var(--text-main);
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(var(--card-shadow-rgb), 0.15);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      z-index: 15;
    }

    .theme-toggle-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: var(--theme-color);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--theme-glow);
    }

    .theme-toggle-btn svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      fill: currentColor;
    }

    /* Ambient Background Glows */
    .glow-container {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .glow-blob {
      position: absolute;
      width: 45vw;
      height: 45vw;
      max-width: 600px;
      max-height: 600px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--theme-glow);
      filter: blur(120px);
      opacity: 0.6;
      transition: background 0.8s ease, transform 15s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
    }

    .glow-1 {
      top: -10%;
      left: -10%;
      animation: drift-1 20s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
    }

    .glow-2 {
      bottom: -10%;
      right: -10%;
      animation: drift-2 20s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes drift-1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
      100% { transform: translate(100px, 80px) scale(1.1); }
    }

    @keyframes drift-2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1.1); }
      100% { transform: translate(-80px, -100px) scale(0.9); }
    }

    /* Main Container */
    main {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 720px;
      z-index: 10;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
      perspective: 1000px;
    }

    /* Card Wrapper (for 3D tilt effect) */
    .ticket-wrapper {
      width: 100%;
      transition: transform 0.1s ease-out;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
    }

    /* Ticket Card Structure - Border, Shadow and Cutouts are now handled by Inline SVG */
    .ticket-card {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: row;
      overflow: visible;
      border: none;
      background: none;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 15px 35px rgba(var(--card-shadow-rgb), 0.22)) drop-shadow(0 0 20px var(--theme-glow));
      transition: filter 0.8s ease;
      transform: translateZ(20px);
    }

    /* SVG Background Layer */
    .ticket-svg-bg {
      position: absolute;
      top: -1px;
      left: -1px;
      width: calc(100% + 2px);
      height: calc(100% + 2px);
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
      filter: drop-shadow(0px 1px 0px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05));
    }

    .ticket-svg-bg path {
      transition: fill 0.5s ease, stroke 0.5s ease;
    }

    .ticket-svg-bg line {
      transition: stroke 0.5s ease;
    }

    /* Ticket Content Container */
    .ticket-content-container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: row;
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow: hidden;
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    }

    /* Left Section (Tear-off Ticket) */
    .ticket-left {
      width: 200px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 40px 24px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .error-code-badge {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .error-code-num {
      font-size: 3.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--text-main);
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      transition: color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .error-code-label {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      color: var(--theme-text);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: color 0.8s ease, background-color 0.8s ease;
      background: var(--theme-bg-soft);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* Left Side Meta Info List */
    .left-meta-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 24px;
      border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    :root.light-mode .left-meta-container {
      border-top: 1px dashed rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1);
    }

    .left-meta-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .left-meta-label {
      font-size: 0.58rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .left-meta-value {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--text-main);
      word-break: break-all;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    /* Right Section (Main Content) */
    .ticket-right {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 40px 44px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .ticket-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .system-label {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    /* Live status pulsing dot */
    .status-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background-color: var(--theme-color);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--theme-color);
      animation: pulse 1.8s infinite;
      transition: background-color 0.8s ease, box-shadow 0.8s ease;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0.6; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.2); opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--theme-color); }
      100% { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0.6; }
    }

    .timestamp-label {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-align: right;
    }

    .ticket-body {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .error-title {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: var(--text-main);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .error-desc {
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    /* Boarding Pass Style Meta Info */
    .ticket-meta-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px 20px;
      margin-top: 10px;
      padding-top: 18px;
      border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    :root.light-mode .ticket-meta-grid {
      border-top: 1px dashed rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1);
    }

    .meta-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .meta-item.full-width {
      grid-column: span 3;
    }

    .meta-label {
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .meta-value {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--text-main);
      word-break: break-all;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Full-width callout for URL Path */
    .meta-item.full-width .meta-value {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--theme-text);
      background: var(--theme-bg-soft);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--theme-color);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      word-break: break-all;
      transition: color 0.5s ease, background-color 0.5s ease, border-color 0.5s ease;
    }

    .ticket-footer {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      margin-top: 12px;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .diagnostic-teaser {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .teaser-label {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .teaser-value {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      max-width: 250px;
    }

    /* Report Button Group & CTA */
    .report-action-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .btn-report-cta {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--theme-text);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      animation: bounce-small 2s infinite ease-in-out;
      transition: color 0.5s ease;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }

    @keyframes bounce-small {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-3px); }
    }

    /* WhatsApp Action Button */
    .btn-report {
      background: var(--theme-color);
      color: #ffffff;
      border: none;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--theme-glow);
      transition: background-color 0.8s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-report:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px var(--theme-color);
      filter: brightness(1.1);
    }

    .btn-report:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .btn-report svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      fill: currentColor;
    }

    /* Info Note Box */
    .info-note {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 18px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      transition: background-color 0.5s ease, border-color 0.5s ease;
    }

    .info-note-title {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--text-main);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .info-note-title svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      fill: var(--theme-text);
      transition: fill 0.8s ease;
    }

    .info-note-desc {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* Mobile Adaptations */
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      body {
        padding: 20px 12px;
        justify-content: flex-start; /* Ensures natural scroll and prevents header overlap */
      }

      .page-header {
        margin-bottom: 8px;
      }

      .ticket-card {
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      .ticket-content-container {
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      .ticket-left {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        padding: 16px 14px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .error-code-badge {

    function formatIndonesianDate(date) {
      const months = [
        'JANUARI', 'FEBRUARI', 'MARET', 'APRIL', 'MEI', 'JUNI',
        'JULI', 'AGUSTUS', 'SEPTEMBER', 'OKTOBER', 'NOVEMBER', 'DESEMBER'
      ];
      const day = date.getDate();
      const monthIndex = date.getMonth();
      const year = date.getFullYear();
      const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
      const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
      const seconds = String(date.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
      return `${day} ${months[monthIndex]} ${year} - ${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds} WIB`;
    }

    document.getElementById('ui-time').textContent = formatIndonesianDate(new Date());

    function sanitizeProxyToken(id, fallback) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return fallback;
      const text = el.textContent.trim();
      if (text.startsWith('::') && text.endsWith('::')) {
        return fallback;
      }
      // Check for SSI tags that didn't render
      if (text.startsWith('<!--') && text.endsWith('-->')) {
        return fallback;
      }
      return text || fallback;
    }

    function drawTicketOutline() {
      const card = document.querySelector('.ticket-card');
      const svgPath = document.getElementById('ticket-svg-path');
      const svgDash = document.getElementById('ticket-svg-dash');
      if (!card || !svgPath || !svgDash) return;

      const w = card.offsetWidth;
      const h = card.offsetHeight;
      const r = 12; // Notch radius
      const cr = 18; // Card corner radius
      const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 600;
      let d = '';

      if (!isMobile) {
        const leftSection = document.querySelector('.ticket-left');
        const x = leftSection ? leftSection.offsetWidth : 200;

        d = `M ${cr} 0 `;
        d += `L ${x - r} 0 `;
        d += `A ${r} ${r} 0 0 0 ${x + r} 0 `;
        d += `L ${w - cr} 0 A ${cr} ${cr} 0 0 1 ${w} ${cr} `;
        d += `L ${w} ${h - cr} A ${cr} ${cr} 0 0 1 ${w - cr} ${h} `;
        d += `L ${x + r} ${h} `;
        d += `A ${r} ${r} 0 0 0 ${x - r} ${h} `;
        d += `L ${cr} ${h} A ${cr} ${cr} 0 0 1 0 ${h - cr} `;
        d += `L 0 ${cr} A ${cr} ${cr} 0 0 1 ${cr} 0 Z`;

        svgPath.setAttribute('d', d);
        svgDash.setAttribute('x1', x);
        svgDash.setAttribute('y1', r);
        svgDash.setAttribute('x2', x);
        svgDash.setAttribute('y2', h - r);
      } else {
        const leftSection = document.querySelector('.ticket-left');
        const y = leftSection ? leftSection.offsetHeight : 120;

        d = `M ${cr} 0 `;
        d += `L ${w - cr} 0 A ${cr} ${cr} 0 0 1 ${w} ${cr} `;
        d += `L ${w} ${y - r} `;
        d += `A ${r} ${r} 0 0 0 ${w} ${y + r} `;
        d += `L ${w} ${h - cr} A ${cr} ${cr} 0 0 1 ${w - cr} ${h} `;
        d += `L ${cr} ${h} A ${cr} ${cr} 0 0 1 0 ${h - cr} `;
        d += `L 0 ${y + r} `;
        d += `A ${r} ${r} 0 0 0 0 ${y - r} `;

        svgPath.setAttribute('d', d);
        svgDash.setAttribute('x1', r);

    // Interactive space particles background canvas
    function initSpaceParticles() {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.id = 'space-particles';
      canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
      canvas.style.top = '0';
      canvas.style.left = '0';
      canvas.style.width = '100vw';
      canvas.style.height = '100vh';
      canvas.style.zIndex = '0';
      canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      document.body.prepend(canvas);

      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      let particles = [];
      const particleCount = 100;
      let mouse = { x: null, y: null, radius: 120 };

      function resizeCanvas() {
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
      }
      resizeCanvas();
      window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

      window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        mouse.x = e.clientX;
        mouse.y = e.clientY;
      });

      window.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        mouse.x = null;
        mouse.y = null;
      });

      class Particle {
        constructor() {
          this.reset(true);
        }

        reset(init = false) {
          this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
          this.y = init ? Math.random() * canvas.height : -10;
          this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
          this.vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4 + 0.15;
          this.radius = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
          this.baseAlpha = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.2;
          this.alpha = this.baseAlpha;
        }

        update() {
          this.x += this.vx;
          this.y += this.vy;

          if (this.x < 0) this.x = canvas.width;
          if (this.x > canvas.width) this.x = 0;
          if (this.y > canvas.height) this.reset();

          if (mouse.x !== null && mouse.y !== null) {
            const dx = this.x - mouse.x;
            const dy = this.y - mouse.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            
            if (dist < mouse.radius) {
              const force = (mouse.radius - dist) / mouse.radius;
              const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
              this.x += Math.cos(angle) * force * 2;
              this.y += Math.sin(angle) * force * 2;
              this.alpha = Math.min(1.0, this.baseAlpha + force * 0.5);
            } else {
              this.alpha = this.baseAlpha;
            }
          } else {
            this.alpha = this.baseAlpha;
          }
        }

        draw() {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(147, 197, 253, ${this.alpha})`;
          ctx.shadowBlur = this.radius * 2;
          ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.4)';
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
        particles.push(new Particle());
      }

      function drawConnections() {
        for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
          const p1 = particles[i];
          
          for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
            const p2 = particles[j];
            const dx = p1.x - p2.x;
            const dy = p1.y - p2.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            
            if (dist < 80) {
              const alpha = (1 - (dist / 80)) * 0.08;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
              ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
              ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(147, 197, 253, ${alpha})`;
              ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }

          if (mouse.x !== null && mouse.y !== null) {
            const dx = p1.x - mouse.x;
            const dy = p1.y - mouse.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            
            if (dist < mouse.radius) {
              const alpha = (1 - (dist / mouse.radius)) * 0.15;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
              ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y);
              ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(167, 139, 250, ${alpha})`;
              ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
        }
      }

      function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        
        particles.forEach(p => {
          p.update();
          p.draw();
        });
        
        drawConnections();
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      }
      
      animate();
    }

    function fetchGeoIP(ip) {
      const providers = [
        {
          name: 'freeipapi',
          url: 'https://freeipapi.com/api/json/' + ip,
          parse: (data) => {
            if (data && data.countryName) {
              const code = data.countryCode || '';
              return (code ? code + ' ' : '') + '(' + data.countryName + ')';
            }
            throw new Error('Invalid freeipapi data');
          }
        },
        {
          name: 'geojs',
          url: 'https://get.geojs.io/v1/ip/geo/' + ip + '.json',
          parse: (data) => {
            if (data && data.country) {
              const code = data.country_code || '';
              return (code ? code + ' ' : '') + '(' + data.country + ')';
            }
            throw new Error('Invalid geojs data');
          }
        },
        {
          name: 'ipwhois',
          url: 'https://ipwho.is/' + ip,
          parse: (data) => {
            if (data && data.success && data.country) {
              const code = data.country_code || '';
              return (code ? code + ' ' : '') + '(' + data.country + ')';
            }
            throw new Error('Invalid ipwhois data');
          }
        },
        {
          name: 'countryis',
          url: 'https://api.country.is/' + ip,
          parse: (data) => {
            if (data && data.country) {
              const code = data.country;
              const names = {
                'ID': 'Indonesia', 'SG': 'Singapore', 'US': 'United States',
                'MY': 'Malaysia', 'JP': 'Japan', 'DE': 'Germany', 'KR': 'South Korea'
              };
              const name = names[code] || code;
              return code + ' (' + name + ')';
            }
            throw new Error('Invalid country.is data');
          }
        }
      ];

      let index = 0;
      function tryNext() {
        if (index >= providers.length) {
          console.error('All GeoIP lookup providers failed');
          const uiGeo = document.getElementById('ui-geo');
          if (uiGeo.textContent === 'Mendeteksi...') {
            uiGeo.textContent = 'Proxy Lokal';
          }
          return;
        }

        const provider = providers[index];
        index++;

        fetch(provider.url)
          .then(res => {
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${provider.name} returned status ${res.status}`);
            return res.json();
          })
          .then(data => {
            const geoText = provider.parse(data);
            const uiGeo = document.getElementById('ui-geo');
            rawGeo = geoText;
            uiGeo.textContent = geoText;
            uiGeo.title = geoText;
            updateWhatsAppUrl();
          })
          .catch(err => {
            console.warn(`${provider.name} failed:`, err);
            tryNext();
          });
      }

      tryNext();
    }

            });
        });
    }

      const uiIp = document.getElementById('ui-ip');
      const uiGeo = document.getElementById('ui-geo');
      
      if (data.ip) {
        rawClientIp = data.ip;
        uiIp.textContent = data.ip;
        uiIp.title = data.ip;

      if (data.loc) {
        const countryMap = {
          'ID': 'ID (Indonesia)',
          'SG': 'SG (Singapore)',
          'US': 'US (United States)',
          'MY': 'MY (Malaysia)',
          'JP': 'JP (Japan)',
          'DE': 'DE (Germany)'
        };
        const geoText = countryMap[data.loc] || data.loc;
        rawGeo = geoText;
        uiGeo.textContent = geoText;
        uiGeo.title = geoText;
      }
      if (rawRayId.startsWith('REQ-') && data.ray) {
        rawRayId = data.ray;
      }
      
      updateWhatsAppUrl();
    }

    function updateErrorCode(code) {

      }

      root.classList.add(details.theme);

        uiCode.textContent = '🛡️';
        uiCode.style.fontSize = '3.0rem';

        uiCode.textContent = '🚨';
        uiCode.style.fontSize = '3.0rem';

**Abstraksi**

Provinsi Jawa Barat Dalam Angka merupakan publikasi BPS Provinsi Jawa Barat yang menyajikan beragam jenis data yang bersumber dari BPS dan institusi lain. Publikasi ini memuat gambaran umum tentang keadaan geografi dan iklim, pemerintahan, serta perkembangan kondisi sosial-demografi dan perekonomian di Provinsi Jawa Barat. Beberapa tabel tertentu menyajikan data pada tingkat provinsi dan kabupaten/kota untuk melihat perbandingan antar wilayah. Untuk memudahkan pemahaman dan pemanfaatan data, disertakan juga penjelasan teknis dari setiap jenis statistik yang disajikan. Implementasi Sistem Informasi Manajemen Data Statistik Terintegrasi (SIMDASI) dilakukan dalam penyusunan Publikasi Provinsi Jawa Barat Dalam Angka 2024 untuk mendukung terciptanya Satu Data Indonesia. Seiring dengan meningkatnya kebutuhan konsumen data, publikasi ini akan terus mengalami penyempurnaan baik struktur maupun muatannya.

artifacts.content: {"id":"waste-law-18-2008","publisher":"Pemerintah Republik Indonesia; official host Direktorat Jenderal Peraturan Perundang-undangan","title":"Undang-Undang Nomor 18 Tahun 2008 tentang Pengelolaan Sampah","url":"https://peraturan.go.id/files/UU%2018%20Tahun%202008.pdf","landingUrl":"https://peraturan.go.id/id/uu-no-18-tahun-2008","originalAcquiredAt":"2026-10-28","auditAccessedAt":"2026-10-28","bytes":206957,"sha256":"6344aa84385626c169d917dfd2a9f643424993dfcbc9663799b9e0f18720b3a3","selectedClauses":{"Pasal 1(5)":"Pengelolaan sampah adalah kegiatan yang sistematis, menyeluruh, dan berkesinambungan yang meliputi pengurangan dan penanganan sampah.","Pasal 2(2)":"Sampah rumah tangga ... berasal dari kegiatan sehari-hari dalam rumah tangga, tidak termasuk tinja dan sampah spesifik.","Pasal 19":["pengurangan sampah","penanganan sampah"],"Pasal 20(1)":["pembatasan timbulan sampah","pendauran ulang sampah","pemanfaatan kembali sampah"],"Pasal 22(1)":["pemilahan","pengumpulan: pengambilan dan pemindahan sampah dari sumber sampah ke tempat penampungan sementara atau tempat pengolahan sampah terpadu","pengangkutan: membawa sampah dari sumber dan/atau TPS/TPST menuju tempat pemrosesan akhir","pengolahan: mengubah karakteristik, komposisi, dan jumlah sampah","pemrosesan akhir: pengembalian sampah dan/atau residu hasil pengolahan sebelumnya ke media lingkungan secara aman"]},"fullPdfRetained":false}

series.name: Jumlah Timbunan Sampah Perkapita Berdasarkan Kabupaten/Kota di Jawa Barat
series.concept: Published daily waste generation per person; not service access.
series.directionExplanation: Greater generated mass is a potential physical waste load, not observed damage; population size and estimation method confound comparisons.

source.referencePeriod: 2023 annual administrative reference; row unit retained unchanged

series.comparability: Same named 2023 field across registry regions; method, geographic catchment and revisions remain unresolved. Published values are not harmonized with BPS table.
series.reportingBias: Numeric row availability is not proof of complete waste measurement, reporting participation, full population coverage, or SIPSN submission. Administrative reporting/estimation methods and independent completeness checks are not supplied.
series.redundancy: BPS Table 4.5.11 republishes corresponding generation/per-capita/handled-like/service columns. TPA transport, handled and service stages may overlap; do not sum or score multiple representations.
caveats: Numeric strings use comma decimal separators; original strings retained.
Metadata does not define whether weighed, sampled or coefficient-estimated. No population denominator reconstructed.
Generation does not measure collection, safe treatment or households served.
No Environment CORE admission: common measurement/reporting completeness is not affirmatively established. Basic Services decisions remain unchanged.

recommendation.reason: Useful published 2023 administrative panel, but verified reporting completeness, common methods and defensible catchment/denominator are missing.

series.name: Jumlah Sampah yang Terangkut ke Tempat Pembuangan Akhir (TPA) Berdasarkan Kabupaten/Kota di Jawa Barat
series.concept: Waste transported to a final disposal site (TPA), daily mass flow; not household collection coverage or safe disposal.
series.directionExplanation: Flow/count alone does not establish environmentally safe treatment or population-normalized pressure.

source.referencePeriod: 2023 annual administrative reference; row unit retained unchanged

series.comparability: Same named 2023 field across registry regions; method, geographic catchment and revisions remain unresolved. Published values are not harmonized with BPS table.
series.reportingBias: Numeric row availability is not proof of complete waste measurement, reporting participation, full population coverage, or SIPSN submission. Administrative reporting/estimation methods and independent completeness checks are not supplied.
series.redundancy: BPS Table 4.5.11 republishes corresponding generation/per-capita/handled-like/service columns. TPA transport, handled and service stages may overlap; do not sum or score multiple representations.
caveats: No assurance that transport to TPA implies sanitary landfill, safe processing or environmental compliance.
Can include non-household municipal-like waste; access distribution and collection frequency unmeasured.
Do not add this tonnage to handled/managed tonnage: stages can concern the same waste and overlap is not defined.
No Environment CORE admission: common measurement/reporting completeness is not affirmatively established. Basic Services decisions remain unchanged.

recommendation.reason: Useful published 2023 administrative panel, but verified reporting completeness, common methods and defensible catchment/denominator are missing.

series.name: Persentase Tingkat Pelayanan Sampah Berdasarkan Kabupaten/Kota di Jawa Barat
series.concept: Published administrative tingkat pelayanan sampah percentage.
series.directionExplanation: Higher published service percentage suggests better administrative service, not verified safe treatment or household access.

source.referencePeriod: 2023 annual administrative reference; row unit retained unchanged

series.comparability: Same named 2023 field across registry regions; method, geographic catchment and revisions remain unresolved. Published values are not harmonized with BPS table.
series.reportingBias: Numeric row availability is not proof of complete waste measurement, reporting participation, full population coverage, or SIPSN submission. Administrative reporting/estimation methods and independent completeness checks are not supplied.
series.redundancy: BPS Table 4.5.11 republishes corresponding generation/per-capita/handled-like/service columns. TPA transport, handled and service stages may overlap; do not sum or score multiple representations.
caveats: Source metadata explicitly says 0 means unavailable/not collected. No 2023 rows equal 0, but this convention must survive future reuse.
BPS Table 4.5.11 publishes close but sometimes 0.01 higher values; no silent reconciliation.
Arithmetic is consistent with TPA transport / BPS daily generation after rounding/truncation, not with handled/managed tonnage / generation. This is an audit inference, not an official formula.
No formal proof that generation covers the full kabupaten/kota population rather than urban or service catchment; no uncertainty or standardized measurement protocol supplied.
No Environment CORE admission: common measurement/reporting completeness is not affirmatively established. Basic Services decisions remain unchanged.

recommendation.reason: Useful published 2023 administrative panel, but verified reporting completeness, common methods and defensible catchment/denominator are missing.

recommendation.reason: Full numeric coverage alone does not establish comparable methods, complete underlying reporting or valid environmental performance denominators.

caveats: Absent regional rows mean no value in this facility dataset, not zero waste or no service.

findings.serviceArithmetic: [INFERENCE] Published tingkat pelayanan resembles 100 * TPA transport / BPS generation after rounding/truncation. It does not resemble handled/generation. This numerical pattern is not an official formula.
findings.residualPolicy: No generation-minus-handled/transport residual is called unmanaged waste. No clipping above100, negative-residual correction, guessed annual conversion or synthetic household denominator.
findings.populationDiagnosticInterpretation: Per-capita implied population is not a verified denominator. Example Kabupaten Tasikmalaya: 155.37 ton/day / 0.33 kg/person/day *1000 = 470818.18 persons, versus 1907050 projected regional population. This does not prove error, but blocks unverified all-population coverage claim.
